src.gen: A plain prison classroom, rows of men in grey jumpsuits sitting cross-legged on a bare floor, a guard watching from the doorway, cinderblock walls, flat fluorescent light
src.move: the men settle into stillness one by one as the guard crosses his arms in the doorway

src.gen: The same prison classroom now crowded, more than half the cell block's men in grey jumpsuits packed onto the floor and along the walls, a guard counting heads from the door
src.move: more men file in through the door and sit down as the guard's eyebrows rise while counting

src.gen: Close view of a prison officer's desk, a stack of carbon-copy disciplinary report forms under a gooseneck lamp, a pen resting on top, a barred window behind showing the cell block
src.move: the officer's pen taps the blank top form once, then sets down untouched

src.gen: The same officer's desk, the stack of disciplinary report forms now gathering a thin layer of dust, a wall calendar nearby with many days crossed off in a row
src.move: the officer glances at the dusty, untouched stack and slowly shakes his head

src.gen: Inside the prison classroom, a long row of grey-jumpsuited men sitting cross-legged with eyes closed in meditation, calm and still, pale morning light through a high barred window
src.move: the men breathe slowly in unison while a guard at the back slowly lowers his folded arms

src.gen: A wide shot of a prison yard, men in grey jumpsuits walking calmly in loose lines instead of clustering in tense groups, a guard tower in the background under pale daylight
src.move: two men who once stood apart now walk side by side, calm, past the guard tower

src.gen: A prison officer standing in a corridor doorway, arms spread wide in disbelief, looking back over his shoulder at the meditation classroom behind him under fluorescent light
src.move: the officer spreads his hands and shakes his head slowly, looking back over his shoulder in disbelief
